title: Heart Failure
case: Presentation (from the chapter): Breathlessness on exertion, orthopnoea (needs pillows to sleep), paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnoea (waking breathless), fatigue, ankle swelling, weight gain, reduced exercise tolerance, fine crackles at lung bases.
qa: Is exercise safe in heart failure? In stable patients, supervised exercise training is safe and improves capacity and quality of life.
What does needing three pillows to sleep suggest? Orthopnoea from pulmonary congestion.
A patient has gained 3 kg in 2 days. What do you do? Postpone training and inform the medical team; possible fluid retention.
What NYHA class is breathlessness on walking a short distance on the flat? Class III.
Why know the ICD threshold? To keep exercise HR safely below it to avoid inappropriate shocks.

redFlags.Finding: Breathless at rest, pink frothy sputum, cannot lie flat
Resting HR or BP outside agreed limits

manualNotes: Monitor HR, BP, SpO2, RPE, symptoms. Longer warm-up and cool-down.
